subject: GreenLane service availability — standup notes and CEO update
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: GreenLane SRE Team <sre@greenlanehealth.com>, Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@greenlanehealth.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Initial notice — elevated error rates impacting /v1/generate for us-west

Hi Lisa / GreenLane SRE,

We observed a spike in 502/timeout responses from the Redwood hosted inference endpoint your traffic is routed to (us-west). Traffic analysis shows a ~35% increase in p50 latency and a concurrent increase in error rate starting ~08:50 PT. We're opening an incident and standing up a bridge now.

What we're doing:
- Routing additional capacity to the us-west pool (in-flight)
- Collecting kernel-level traces and network counters
- Capturing application logs and a sample of failed request payloads for correlation (attachments to follow)

We will keep this message to be the canonical inbound notice to your SRE team. If you have any immediate mitigation (e.g., temporarily divert traffic to eu-central), please let us know.

Ben
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: greenlane_network_logs.zip (14MB)
From: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@greenlanehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: GreenLane SRE Team <sre@greenlanehealth.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:20:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial notice — elevated error rates impacting /v1/generate for us-west

Thanks Ben — we're seeing the same on our side (errors surfaced in production, roughly 3% of user flows). Traffic shift to eu-central is possible but we need to confirm data residency rules for certain patients.

Immediate asks: can Redwood provide a temporary key-based route that preserves org-scoped data locality? Otherwise we'll have to fail open to cached results. Also, do you have an ETA for the capacity reroute?

Lisa
Director, Platform Engineering, GreenLane Health

--
GreenLane SRE thread: please add incident notes to INC-4721
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: bridge triage and play assignments — GreenLane

Team — quick coordination note from the bridge:
- Ben, owners for customer comms and log correlation (on it).
- Karthik, runtime / kernel team to verify whether a recent kernel selector change in us-west could cause increased mem pressure.
- Marissa, leadership/customer escalation and any exec-facing comms.

Work items we authorized on the bridge:
1) Roll back kernel selector experiment on a subset of nodes (canary) — Karthik to run immediately.
2) Deploy temporary traffic duplication to eu-central for GreenLane only (no data replication) so they can validate behavior without crossing residency boundaries — network team to create key-based route.
3) Prepare an executive note that summarizes impact, mitigation, and next steps for GreenLane CEO & CIO (Marissa).

Please post progress to the shared drive link and update PagerDuty INC-4721. I want a 1-line status every 30 minutes for the next 3 hours.

Hiro
Principal Incident Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@greenlanehealth.com>, GreenLane SRE Team <sre@greenlanehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, contracts@greenlanehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood executive update for GreenLane — temporary measures and CEO note

Lisa / GreenLane leadership,

I'm Marissa Cole, Head of Customer Operations at Redwood. I wanted to provide a concise executive update while our engineers continue remediation. Key points:

Summary of impact
- Start: 2028-08-14 08:50 PT.
- Scope: Intermittent 502s and increased latency affecting ~3% of GreenLane's production requests routed to us-west. No persistent data loss detected.

Actions taken
- We rolled back a recently selected kernel path on a canary subset of nodes (in progress).
- Created a key-scoped route that duplicates GreenLane traffic to eu-central for validation (does not replicate persistent patient data).
- Additional capacity has been provisioned; we continue to monitor error rates and latency distributions.

Immediate customer-facing mitigations we recommend
- If GreenLane can accept eu-central traffic for validation only (no storage), please confirm; we will enable the keyed route within 30 minutes of confirmation.
- If data residency prevents that, we'll continue to scale us-west capacity and run the canary rollback more broadly.

Next steps and commitments
- We'll provide a follow-up update at 14:30 PT with current error-rate metrics and preliminary root-cause indications.
- Post-incident: Redwood will deliver a formal postmortem within 72 hours and share the postmortem draft (postmortem-draft.md) for your review.

I understand the sensitivity here given patient-data considerations. If you'd like, I can schedule a short CEO-to-CEO note to reassure leadership while we stabilize.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com | +1 (415) 555-0178

Attachment: postmortem-draft.md (to be populated after closure)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@greenlanehealth.com>, GreenLane SRE Team <sre@greenlanehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Incident status — stabilization and next steps (final for now)

Update (14:22 PT):
- Kernel canary rollback verified on the broader us-west pool; error rate reduced to baseline (~0.5%) and p50 latency returned to normal.
- The keyed eu-central route was enabled for GreenLane for validation; no functional regressions seen in the duplicated traffic.
- We attached collected logs and a brief timeline to the shared drive for your postmortem review.

Next steps:
- Redwood will circulate a formal postmortem draft by 2028-08-17 14:00 PT. We will include action items for additional pre-deployment verification and an expansion of canary coverage to catch similar regressions earlier.
- If GreenLane would like an executive summary formatted for the CEO/CISO, Marissa can finalize and run it by you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks for the collaboration and patience. If anything reappears, reply here and we'll re-open the bridge immediately.

Ben
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
